cohort: 24 pregnant women diagnosed with PAS and placenta previa at Regional Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS) in Imphal, Manipur, India, between January 2018 and March 2020.
finding: Prior cesarean section was the predominant risk factor for PAS (100% of cases), and planned cesarean deliveries were the most common mode of delivery (89.7%), with significant differences in blood loss observed between those with one prior cesarean section and those with multiple prior cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean sections were infrequent but associated with lower fetal Apgar scores.
